product: Life sciences and diagnostics portfolio: Cytiva bioprocessing, Pall filtration, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, Cepheid, Leica Biosystems, Radiometer, Abcam, IDT, Aldevron and SCIEX, plus Masimo pulse oximetry and patient monitoring added June 2026.
demand: Improving: large pharma and biopharma demand healthy, biotech funding converting into orders, clinical and applied markets strong, academic and government stabilized but soft, high-growth markets up over 10 percent, China growing mid-single digits.
pricing_power: Moderate to strong on differentiated, mission-critical consumables and filtration, but growth is volume-led and price is not cited as a driver; tariffs and commodity costs are headwinds.
competition: Bioprocessing from Thermo Fisher, Sartorius, Repligen and Avantor; diagnostics from Abbott, Roche and Siemens Healthineers; patient monitoring from Nihon Kohden, Philips and GE HealthCare. Management cites a differentiated portfolio and share gains.
team: CEO transition: Julie Sawyer Montgomery becomes CEO 2026-10-01 after leading Diagnostics from about 6 billion to about 11 billion dollars in revenue; Rainer Blair retires and is an advisor until 2027-03-31; CFO Matt Gugino; Danaher Business System culture; about 60000 associates.
market_strategy: Acquisition-led capital deployment into life sciences and diagnostics: Masimo closed June 2026, StatLab acquisition pending, 500 million euro senior notes priced April 2026, targeting mid-single-digit core growth, a bioprocessing reshoring capex cycle, DBS-driven productivity and share gains.
bull: Q2 2026 revenue $6.3B up 5.5%, core up 3.0%, FY26 EPS guidance raised to 8.45-8.60; bioprocessing orders up mid-teens and Masimo closed 2026-06-10 adds $0.15-0.20 EPS year one.
bear: Gross margin fell 2.71pp, 90-day analyst revisions net -4 with median target -4.84%, over $100M resin shipments pushed to 2027, Q3 core guided to 2-3%, and Masimo adds $9.9B deal debt.
falsifier: Q3 2026 earnings on 2026-10-21: core growth below the guided 2-3% or a cut to the FY26 adjusted EPS range of 8.45-8.60.
web_what_changed: Closed Masimo acquisition 2026-06-10 at 180 dollars per share cash, about 9.9 billion dollars enterprise value. Q2 2026 results 2026-07-21: revenue 6.3 billion dollars, up 5.5 percent, core up 3.0 percent, adjusted EPS 1.94, full year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance raised to 8.45 to 8.60. Julie Sawyer Montgomery named CEO 2026-08-03, effective October 1, Rainer Blair retiring. Dividend of 0.40 declared 2026-09-15.
web_not_known_yesterday: not found. Latest dated company disclosure is the 2026-08-03 CEO appointment; no 2026-09-24 or 2026-09-25 filing or news release was found. EDGAR shows no September 2026 8-K, and the news count for the last 30 days is zero.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Volume and demand led, not price. Core revenue up 3.0 percent, 4.5 percent excluding respiratory testing. Growth came from end-market recovery, bioprocessing consumables and equipment orders up mid-teens, biotech funding converting into orders, and high-growth markets up over 10 percent, with China mid-single-digit. Drag from chromatography resin shipment timing, over 100 million dollars pushed into 2027, plus lower respiratory testing.
web_suppliers: Danaher is mainly a supplier of bioprocessing and diagnostics products. As a buyer it cites risk from cost and availability of supplies including commodities and from tariffs. No named constrained supplier was disclosed; not found.
web_customers: Large pharma and biopharma plus clinical and applied markets; academic and government are under 5 percent of revenue. Concentration: a few large commercial biologics manufacturers drove the chromatography resin shipment delays, and Aldevron has two large customers. Pall sells to semiconductor and memory makers. No single-customer percentage disclosed; not found.
web_who_loses: Competitors: Thermo Fisher, Sartorius, Repligen and Avantor in bioprocessing; Abbott, Roche and Siemens Healthineers in diagnostics; Nihon Kohden, Philips and GE HealthCare in patient monitoring where Masimo competes. Hospitals and labs also lose supplier choice as Danaher scale and bundling grow.
web_contradicting_evidence: Bioprocessing missed: over 100 million dollars of chromatography resin shipments pushed into 2027, about 500 basis points off Q2 bioprocessing growth. Q3 2026 core guided to 2 to 3 percent, below Q2. Respiratory is about a 250 basis point headwind. Academic and government funding weak. China policy pressure. Masimo adds deal debt and integration risk. Analysts were net negative over 90 days.
web_if_management_right: Core growth exits 2026 at mid-single digits with full year adjusted EPS of 8.45 to 8.60. Bioprocessing returns to high-single-digit growth as delayed resin ships in 2027 inside a multi-year reshoring capex cycle. Masimo adds 0.15 to 0.20 dollars in the first full year and about 0.70 by year five, while Diagnostics and specialty franchises grow high single digits.
web_if_management_wrong: Resin orders do not convert and the 2027 bioprocessing guide is cut, so EPS misses. Masimo integration, synergy delivery and 9.9 billion dollars of deal debt weigh on cash flow and leverage. Respiratory and academic weakness persist. The stock at about 26 times forward earnings de-rates as visibility deteriorates.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: CDMOs and biologics capacity builders, chromatography resin and raw-material suppliers, filtration and single-use component makers, lab construction and reshoring supply chains, CROs and biotech tools vendors, the Alzheimer blood-test ecosystem around p-tau217, and semiconductor and memory filtration chains served by Pall in Singapore.
